title: Oxygen Reference
description: The reference rule shared by every schema field that names another asset or file (Oxygen/Content/Docs/virtual_paths.md, References). A reference is a virtual path in another mount, or text relative to the folder that holds the referring file. This definition refuses what a pattern can express; the cooker resolves the reference and reports the rule's vpath.* code for the rest (the mount rule, the segment rule, a climb above the mount, absolute text in the file's own mount, derived content in an asset reference).

reference.description: Absolute ('/Engine/Materials/Default.omat') or relative ('Brick.otex', './Brick.otex', '../Textures/Brick.otex'). Relative text starts with one './' or any number of '../', then one or more segments; no '.' or '..' after that, no empty segment, no trailing '/', no control characters and none of \ : * ? " < > |. Segments are plain text: no percent-encoding, and no asset:/// URIs.
